name: Fabric Textile Products, Inc.
old_description: We specialize in high quality home decor products. Take your designs and ideas to the next level.
about:
Based in Clifton, New Jersey, Fabric Textile Products, Inc. operates as a print-on-demand manufacturer and fulfillment provider for custom home decor products. The company emphasizes domestic production, with all printing and fulfillment conducted at its New Jersey facility.

The company specializes in made-to-order production of home decor items, offering a print-on-demand model that eliminates inventory risk for its clients. It accepts orders as small as a single unit and processes them through an integrated workflow that includes custom printing, personalized inserts, packaging, and direct shipping. The facility supports API integration for automated order routing, and the company states that orders leave the facility within 48 hours.

Fabric Textile Products serves e-commerce businesses and brands that sell custom home decor products. Its platform-agnostic approach allows clients to connect via their own API or the company's API, targeting sellers who want to outsource manufacturing and fulfillment without holding stock.

The company positions its domestic manufacturing and rapid turnaround as key differentiators, promoting a "no inventory risk" model that enables clients to scale without upfront production commitments. Its focus on made-in-USA production and same-facility fulfillment is intended to reduce lead times and simplify supply chains for small- to mid-sized online retailers.
